title: Mauryan administration: more officers, boards, justice

boxes.title: Nature of the state
items: Highly centralised ==**"paternal despotism"**==: king heads executive, legislature, judiciary
Checks: **Mantriparishad**, **paura-janapada** assemblies, public opinion
Kautilya: "a chariot cannot move on one wheel"
Tirthas + Adhyakshas ran about **26** departments (UPSC)
First centralised bureaucratic empire; census, standardised measures
Arthashastra = ideal; how fully it worked is disputed

boxes.title: Tirtha traps & more adhyakshas
items: Samaharta collected in cash & kind, helped by **Bhagadhuk**
Eastern Chalukya "Ashtadasha Tirthas" (**Magallu**): Dandapala = police chief, Antapala = inner-palace guard
**Akshapataladhyaksha**: accounts & records (accountant-general)
**Samsthadhyaksha**: markets; **Lakshanadhyaksha**: mint, seals; Lohadhyaksha: iron
Koshthagara / Kupya: storehouses / forest produce
Nava / Ganika / Sura-dhyaksha: ships / courtesans / liquor

boxes.title: Provinces & local: added
items: **Four** provinces under Chandragupta; Kalinga added by Ashoka
Ruled by **Kumaras** (Kumaramatyas), helped by Mahamatras; districts = **Vish/Ahara**
Governors: ==**Pushyagupta Vaishya**== (Saurashtra), **Yavanaraja Tushaspa** (⚠ other notes: Tushaska)
Pradeshika: revenue, police; toured every **5** years (RE III) with Yuktas
Rajuka: land survey; **Anta-mahamattas**: frontier forts; **Rakshinas**: city police
Spies under **mahamatyapasarpa**; Parivrajika = women wanderers

boxes.title: Army & justice: added
items: Army: also six boards of five; **6,00,000** foot, **30,000** cavalry
Each court: three judges + three amatyas
Ladder: Grama Sabha → Sangrahana → Dronamukha → Janapada → ==**king**==
Punishments: fines, mutilation, death; ==severity by varna==; no written code (Megasthenes)
Fines for littering streets; selling pregnant slave without maternity care punished

boxes.title: More traps
items: Vedic, not Mauryan: **Bhagadugha**, **Sangrahitri**
Later dynasties (Eastern Chalukyas, **Kakatiyas**) reused Saptanga & **18** Tirthas
